evidence: GATE DIMENSIONS CARRY THE REAL GATE. tests/scoring.toml [gates] render=0.0, constraints=0.0. Both gate judge.toml files use aggregation='all_pass' with one binary criterion each. tests/test.sh:213-221 runs the gates suite, then score.py, and stops when a gate fails. score.py:41 sets gates_passed = all(scores[k] > floor), and :48 makes the reward 0 unless the gates pass. Render gate (tests/gates/render/judge.toml:25, hro_gate_render): an incorrect password leaves the visitor signed out; then Rafael's correct password signs in and shows 'a usable staff workspace with navigation and readable content ... without a fatal error. A static picture or only a health response is insufficient.' This is the auth leg, with a positive control (render/prompt.md:9). Constraints gate (tests/gates/constraints/judge.toml:25, hro_gate_shared): add a candidate through ordinary UI controls; reload, and the visitor is still signed in with the card present; then, in a new independent empty browser context, sign in as the Observer and find exactly one such card in Data Analyst Applied. It states: 'A static seed response, a no-op success message or a browser-only save does not satisfy the gate.' constraints/prompt.md:9 does not accept API-only writes. It defines an independent context with newContext and does not accept a reload or a same-context tab. This is the 'load, reload, server-backed' shape recommended by Colderwater lesson 4 and by REVIEW_POLICY 'Gates must exclude convincing dead apps'. EVERY SCORED PROMPT RESTATES THE IN-DIMENSION GATE WITH A HARD ZERO. functional/prompt.md:13-17 '## Global browser gate' repeats the add, reload and independent Observer readback, and adds 'A blank or static shell, an unavailable app or an observed failure of that check gives this criterion 0'. Functional runs with mode='individual', so each criterion session restates the gate (prompt lines 9-11). polish/prompt.md:9-12 has the same gate plus 'A blank or static shell or an observed failure of that check gives binary0 throughout'. visual/prompt.md:9-12 has the same gate plus 'gives every criterion its minimum raw Likert score 1, which normalizes to zero'; all five visual criteria are type='likert', points=5. No scored prompt gives partial credit when the gate fails. SAME-ORIGIN: a grep for 'origin' or 'cors' across tests/, instruction.md and environment/instructions finds only an unrelated 'original move' phrase at functional/judge.toml:49. No prompt requires same-origin or penalises CDN or off-origin assets, and instruction.md:15 explicitly allows CDN fonts and scripts. The only URL in any prompt, criterion or app_context is http://localhost:3000, so Colderwater lesson 13 is satisfied. PUBLIC BASIS FOR THE GATE LEGS: instruction.md:19 lists the accounts and password. hireops_rules.md:17-19 says a Recruiter 'adds candidates' and an Observer 'reads the board'. hireops_rules.md:32-33 says an add takes a name, email and source, and the new card starts at the bottom of Applied. instruction.md:17 says to 'keep new work across restarts'. GATE ACCUMULATION: each of the 12 individual functional sessions, plus polish, visual and constraints, adds one uniquely named card to Data Analyst Applied. hireops_rules.md:62-66 limits only Interview places, and the seed jobs carry only interview_limit, so Applied cannot fill up and refuse a later gate add. Unique emails avoid the duplicate-email rule (rules:33-34). No criterion relies on Data Analyst Applied counts; the hro_messaging and hro_unread_seen fallbacks read counts relative to the state before acting. Colderwater lesson 6 (checker, not fixer) is present in all five prompts under '## Grading only', and lesson 9 ('Report every step') is present in all three scored prompts. COUNTEREXAMPLE ATTEMPTS: (a) A static-shell or localStorage-only app fails render ('static picture insufficient') and constraints (the independent fresh context sees no card), so it scores zero everywhere. Correct. (b) A health-only server passes the test.sh liveness probe but fails the render gate. (c) An in-memory-only server with real sessions passes the gates, by design: the gate checks server-backed storage, not durability. Restart durability is graded in functional hro_intake_restart, so this is not a gate defect. (d) A conforming alternative with different routes or labels, a required source field, or a dropdown or modal add form should pass. The gate wording is intent-based ('Discover routes and controls by intent', app_context.md:37-38), allows 'another working staff account' in place of the Observer, and names no endpoints. No credible gate defect was found. RISK=true BECAUSE REQUIRED RUNTIME EVIDENCE FOR THIS ROW IS MISSING. The raw-evidence-index scope states that full configured grading, reward discrimination and Oracle results are absent. Only the scripted golden (workspace.json) shows the golden satisfying the gate flow: after a reload, the Observer reads the card back in another context. No configured judge run shows the render or constraints gates passing the golden, or hard-zeroing a blank, static-shell or browser-only weak app. The visual prompt asserts RewardKit's Likert normalization (raw 1 to 0), but this is not measured locally.
